scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w worker
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build -w frontend
